subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-11-27
html:
Weekly Pulse — Nov 27, 2026

~21 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). Fresh live pull, site_id 12704162.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing on the live site, but this sandbox has no outbound access to the GA4 reporting API, so conversions can't be pulled from here. A scheduled data Action (outside this sandbox) fills this number in later — until then, leading indicators below (rank, backlinks, AI visibility) are the only available signal.

All 22 tracked keywords sat at the not-ranked floor (avg position 100) every single day this period (11/20→11/27), Google USA — unchanged since tracking began 2026-08-01, now 34 straight sessions flat.

Traffic vs last week

No change. SE Ranking's domain overview still returns no ranking keywords for askarlo.app in the US index — no organic footprint to measure traffic from yet, same as every prior pulse.

Anything broken?

No — and one open question from last session closed clean. The 11-26 fix wired /api/indexnow into a new IndexNow Ping GitHub Action, but the sandbox that built it couldn't reach the live internet to confirm the round-trip. Checked this session: the Action's first run (triggered by that push) completed successfully and its logs show HTTP 200 with body {\"status\":202,\"urlsSubmitted\":50} — the live endpoint really did submit all 50 sitemap URLs (including every /connect/* and /compare/* page) to the IndexNow network. Also ran a full local build gate before this report (rm -rf .next & npm install & npm run build): compiled clean, 87/87 pages generated, same 9 pre-existing (app)/* + /welcome Convex-env prerender failures as every prior session (Vercel-only env var, not a regression). All 71 SEO Report Email runs since kickoff are green, 71/71 all-time going into this push (run #72). Backlinks flat at 2 / 1 referring domain, unchanged since 11-10's futurlabs.dev redirect loss. Domain Trust flat at 6. AI Result Tracker still has zero LLM engines configured. Separately: this session's checkout started in a detached-HEAD state, 2 commits ahead of the local main branch (11-26's real, already-worklogged IndexNow fix + its report-archive commit) that had reached origin/main but not the local branch ref — fast-forwarded local main before starting; nothing was lost.

Reading the week

The IndexNow fix is now verified working end-to-end, not just logically correct — a real win, but it's a second-tier signal (Bing/Yandex/Seznam's network, not Google) layered on top of a GSC sitemap submission that still hasn't happened. 34 straight flat sessions on Google rank is now a long enough streak that no further code-level indexation fix is likely to move it alone; the FOCUS content (connector matrix 5/5, comparison hub 5/5, blog 10 posts) remains fully built and exhausted against current keyword demand. The three levers that could actually move rank, backlinks, or AI visibility — GSC sitemap submission, off-page Phase 1 link-building (still 0/6 registries), and configuring an AI Result Tracker LLM engine — all stay human-gated going into week 22.
